title: The Origins of Sounding Canvas
excerpt: An archival exploration of the earliest Sounding Canvas experiments that eventually led to the creation of Perceptrum. This story traces the transition from technical research and augmented musical instruments toward interactive paintings, spatial sound, and relational artistic environments.

title: The Epistemology of Touch: Reclaiming the Relational Object
excerpt: A theoretical reflection on touch, relational objects, augmented paintings, and post-immersive scenography developed through the artistic research of Perceptrum².

title: Sounding Canvas at Norrsken | Perceptrum² Live Event (June 4)
excerpt: A conversation at Norrsken about our practice: from demonstration to a relational and epistemological shift. Through our Augmented Painting, Sounding Canvas, we explore how invisible computation can activate physical space and redefine interaction as embodied co-presence.

title: The Conceptual Foundations of Augmented Painting
excerpt: A foundational text introducing the concept of Augmented Painting, the Relational Object, and Perceptrum²'s vision of interaction as a distributed form of intelligence.

title: From Interactive Art to Relational Painting | The Emergence of Augmented Painting
excerpt: A Perceptrum essay introducing Augmented Painting as a new artistic medium and Relational Painting as a new curatorial paradigm emerging from the evolution of Sounding Canvas.

title: Sounding Stage | Inhabitable Augmented Painting | Perceptrum
excerpt: Sounding Stage expands our ontology of Augmented Painting into an inhabitable, distributed environment, where four interconnected canvases transform the entire scenography into a single, sensing, and unified artwork.

title: Sounding Canvas at Berlin Science Week 2026: Two Portals Across a Relational Medium
excerpt: At Berlin Science Week 2026 with Hidden Variable, Perceptrum² deployed the third version of the Sounding Canvas Event Manager built on the Variational Framework, linking a portable Sounding Canvas and the studio version of Echo of Lines as two symmetric portals across a shared relational medium.
